properties.description:
`Scoped` carries `share_of_anchored` — the fraction of the design's ANCHORED findings this 'narrowed' answer holds — plus a `narrowing_note` that appears in words when that exceeds SCOPE_IS_BARELY_NARROWER_AT (0.5).

THE DENOMINATOR IS THE DESIGN. It is `in_scope + out_of_scope`, deliberately not `total`: unanchored findings are statements about the design as a whole and could never fall inside ANY region, so dividing by `total` would flatter every scoped answer by a constant and make regions look narrower than they are.

THE THRESHOLD IS A JUDGEMENT AND IS ADMISSIBLE ANYWAY. `dec:report-dont-judge` normally forbids one. It is allowed here because the finding is about THIS TOOL'S OWN ANSWER rather than about the design: saying 'the narrowing you asked for did not narrow' is the instrument reporting on itself, which is the one place a judgement is owed rather than withheld. The threshold is named in the message so a reader can disagree with it rather than having to discover it.

MEASURED AGAINST THE OLD DEFAULT AS A CONTROL: over all 56 Components of reflow2's own design the note fires 56 of 56 at depth 3, and 0 of 56 at the new default of 2.

BOTH DETECTORS GET IT. Gaps and defects both return `Scoped`, and a self-check only one of them performed would be exactly the half-applied rule that made the vacuity note need repairing twice.
properties.name: A scoped read reports how much of the design it still holds, and says in words when that is most of it
